engineering_interpretation: This diagram illustrates the signal flow and control logic for the front fog lamp large screen request function, showing how the Integrated Central Body Controller (ICB) initiates the request and how it propagates through the Left and Right Hand Zone Control Units (LHZCU, RHZCU) to control the Left and Right Headlight Assemblies (LHA, RHA) and the tail light assemblies.
